measure: two P2 uploads, two assessments (one followup), readiness and persisted lesson advancement; no generation or TTS

sql_inventory.sql:
SELECT learner_profiles.user_id 
FROM learner_profiles JOIN users ON users.id = learner_profiles.user_id 
WHERE learner_profiles.user_id = %(user_id_1)s::UUID

SELECT
      set_config('lock_timeout',CASE WHEN current_setting('lock_timeout')::interval=interval '0' OR current_setting('lock_timeout')::interval>interval '1 second' THEN '1000ms' ELSE current_setting('lock_timeout') END,true),
      set_config('statement_timeout',CASE WHEN current_setting('statement_timeout')::interval=interval '0' OR current_setting('statement_timeout')::interval>interval '5 seconds' THEN '5000ms' ELSE current_setting('statement_timeout') END,true)
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(%(key)s)
SELECT public.poc_stage_read(CAST(%(owner)s AS uuid),CAST(%(ex)s AS uuid),CAST(%(id)s AS uuid))

SELECT public.poc_stage_claim(CAST(%(owner)s AS uuid),CAST(%(id)s AS uuid),CAST(%(ex)s AS uuid),%(kind)s,%(hash)s,%(old)s,%(expires)s,CAST(%(snapshot)s AS jsonb),CAST(%(input)s AS jsonb),CAST(%(rows)s AS jsonb))

SELECT
      set_config('lock_timeout',CASE WHEN current_setting('lock_timeout')::interval=interval '0' OR current_setting('lock_timeout')::interval>interval '1 second' THEN '1000ms' ELSE current_setting('lock_timeout') END,true),

SELECT public.poc_stage_read(CAST(%(owner)s AS uuid),CAST(%(ex)s AS uuid),CAST(%(id)s AS uuid))
SELECT public.poc_stage_apply(CAST(%(owner)s AS uuid),CAST(%(id)s AS uuid),%(fence)s,CAST(%(rows)s AS jsonb),true,%(fail)s)

SELECT attempts.id, attempts.exercise_id, attempts.transcription, attempts.recognized_text, attempts.confidence, attempts.transcription_source, attempts.confirmed_text, attempts.status, attempts.created_at 
FROM attempts JOIN exercises ON exercises.id = attempts.exercise_id 
WHERE attempts.id = %(id_1)s::UUID AND exercises.user_id = %(user_id_1)s::UUID

SELECT lesson_lifecycles.id, lesson_lifecycles.user_id, lesson_lifecycles.status, lesson_lifecycles.revision, lesson_lifecycles.started_at, lesson_lifecycles.data 
FROM lesson_lifecycles 
WHERE lesson_lifecycles.user_id = %(user_id_1)s::UUID AND lesson_lifecycles.id = %(id_1)s::UUID ORDER BY lesson_lifecycles.started_at DESC, lesson_lifecycles.id DESC 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER

SELECT lesson_lifecycles.id, lesson_lifecycles.user_id, lesson_lifecycles.status, lesson_lifecycles.revision, lesson_lifecycles.started_at, lesson_lifecycles.data 
FROM lesson_lifecycles 
WHERE lesson_lifecycles.user_id = %(user_id_1)s::UUID AND lesson_lifecycles.id = %(id_1)s::UUID ORDER BY lesson_lifecycles.started_at DESC, lesson_lifecycles.id DESC 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER
